Engineering Product Portfolio

Every damper is custom engineered to customer process parameters using 3D CAD modeling, FEA stress verification, and CFD flow optimization.

BE-10 Series
Isolation & Throttling Ø40 - Ø7,000 mm

Butterfly Damper Valves

Manufactured in sizes up to 7000 mm in round shape and up to 12000 mm in rectangular shape. Features concentric or offset single disc for corrosive, abrasive, and hazardous gas flows.

Pressure:Up to 10,197 mmWC
Temp Range:-25°C to +825°C
Leak Tightness:Class IV / VI (99.5% - 100%)
100% Man-Safe
Zero-Leakage Barrier Ø300 - Ø7,000 mm

Air Seal Damper Valves

100% sealing efficiency achieved by injecting pressurized, preheated seal air into the tandem flap gap. Creates an impenetrable barrier protecting personnel during maintenance.

Sealing:100% Zero-Leak (Seal Air)
Temp Range:-25°C to +825°C
Actuation:Electric / Pneumatic + Blower
PN25 High Pressure
Double Cam Action Ø150 - Ø3,500 mm

Double Offset Butterfly Damper

Features dual shaft offsets creating cam action during rotation to minimize seat contact and wear. Provides 100% leak tightness up to PN25 rating for gas handling.

Pressure:PN10 / PN16 / PN25
Temp Range:-25°C to +250°C
Sealing:100% Bubble-Tight Shutoff
650°C Metal Seated
Conical Cam Geometry Ø150 - Ø1,200 mm

Triple Offset Butterfly Damper

Third conical offset eliminates friction between metal seal ring and body seat. Delivers bi-directional zero-leakage shutoff in high temperature hydrocarbon and severe steam services.

Sealing:Metal-to-Metal Zero Leakage
Temp Range:-25°C to +650°C
Standards:API 609 Cat. B / ASME B16.34
Fabricated Wedge
Dirty Gas Isolation DN200 - DN3,000

Double Disc Gate Valves

Metal-to-metal sealing with dual-disc wedging action and Stellite hardfacing. Engineered specifically for dirty, dust-laden gas streams where complete flow bore opening is required.

Bore Flow:100% Full Port / Zero Drop
Sealing:Mechanical Wedging + Purge
Hardfacing:Stellite / Carbide Seats
Nuclear Qualified
Frictionless Seating Ø300 - Ø2,500 mm

Three Lever Shut Off Damper

Kinematic 3-lever linkage rotates the disc 90° then pushes it perpendicular to the seat at the final closing moment. Eliminates friction wear in radioactive and toxic gas conduits.

Pressure:Up to PN25
Applications:Nuclear / Toxic Gas Isolation
Sealing:100% Positive Perpendicular
Full Duct Isolation
Sliding Blade Gate Up to 6000 x 6000 mm

Guillotine Damper Valves

Heavy-duty sliding plate dampers driven by rack and pinion, screw, or chain drives. Designed for boiler gas duct isolation during shutdown with zero pressure loss in open condition.

Drive Options:Rack & Pinion, Screw, Chain
Seal System:Inconel Spring / Seal Air Skid
Duty:Heavy Ash / Particulate Loads
Aerodynamic Modulation
Opposed / Parallel Blades Span to 6,000 mm

Multi-Louver Damper Valves

Multiple interconnected aerodynamic blades providing linear airflow modulation and low operating torque. Available in opposed blade (modulation) or parallel blade (rapid shutoff) options.

Control Signal:4-20 mA HART / Modulating
Temp Range:Up to 750°C
Sealing:Up to 99.5% with SS Seals
CCGT / HRSG Bypass
Flow Redirection Up to DN4000

Three Way Diverter Dampers

Rapidly switches high-temperature gas turbine exhaust between boiler (HRSG) and bypass stack. Equipped with continuous seal air purge for 100% human-safe maintenance access.

Trip Speed:< 30 Seconds Emergency
Actuation:Hydraulic Power Pack / Electric
Isolation:100% with Pressurized Air
Baghouse Isolation
Fast Pneumatic Stroke DN400 - DN2,500

Poppet Damper Valves

Engineered for baghouse pulse-jet compartment isolation and reverse gas cleaning cycles. Pneumatic stroke completes in 3-5 seconds with resilient elastomeric or metal seat options.

Stroke Time:3 to 5 Seconds
Mounting:Vertical or Horizontal Run
Configurations:2-Way / 3-Way Arrangements
Inline Flow Line
Straight Pipeline Run DN100 - DN1,200

Straight Pattern (Inline) Valves

In-line shutoff and flow balancing valves installed directly in process gas pipelines. Built with robust carbon steel or stainless housings with manual handwheel, gearbox, or motor drives.

Orientation:Coaxial Straight Inline
Operation:Manual / Motorized Multi-Turn
Temp Rating:Up to 450°C
90° Directional
Elbow Diversion DN150 - DN1,400

Right Angle Valves

Combines 90-degree pipeline directional turning with tight process gas shutoff. Saves valuable plant footprint by replacing a duct elbow and isolation valve combination.

Geometry:90-Degree Integral Elbow
Media:Hot Air, Flue Gas, Combustion
Space Saving:Replaces 90° Elbow + Valve
Sugar & Ethanol
Flush Bottom Seat DN200 - DN800

Crystallizer Discharge Gate Valves

Specially fabricated flush-bottom gate valves for sugar, chemical, ethanol and fertilizer crystallization pans. Guarantees rapid discharge without dead-pocket slurry build-up.

Material:SS304L / SS316L Contact
Design:Pocketless Flush Bottom
Operation:Motorized / Pneumatic Cylinder
Emergency Fast Shut
Tunnel & Marine Duct Custom Duct Sizes

Ventilation Channel Closing Device

Rapid emergency closing device designed for HVAC ventilation tunnels, naval vessels, nuclear shelters, and hazardous industrial ventilation shafts with instant fail-safe actuation.

Mechanism:Fast Spring Return / Pneumatic
Closure Time:< 1 Second Emergency Trigger
Construction:Impact-Resistant Fabricated
1,200°C Ultra-High Temp
Severe Thermal Resilience DN300 - DN3,500

Refractory Lined Damper Valves

Body and disc lined with dense high-alumina refractory castable cast over stainless anchor studs. Built to survive abrasive 1200°C flue gas in cement kilns, incinerators, and smelters.

Design Temp:Up to 1,200°C Continuous
Lining:High-Alumina Castable + Studs
Industries:Cement, Steel, Smelting, Waste
Dust Airlock Seal
Hopper Dust Discharge 200x200 to 1200x1200mm

Double Flap Damper Valves

Dual-chamber alternating flap valve maintaining continuous airtight pressure boundary while discharging heavy dust and ash from ESP hoppers, baghouses, and cyclone collectors.

Operation:Motorized Cam / Counterweight
Function:Zero Air Ingress Dust Airlock
Wear Protection:Hardox / Hardfaced Flap Edges
Automatic Non-Return
Gravity / Counterweight Custom Duct Sizing

Back Draft Damper Valves

Low-inertia automatic non-return dampers preventing reverse gas flow and wind-milling in parallel ID/FD fan networks and plant ventilation discharges.

Operation:Pressure Differential Trigger
Blades:Precision Balanced Low-Inertia
Duty:ID / FD Fan Discharge Lines
Equilibrium Balanced
Balanced Dual Seat DN200 - DN1,500

Fabricated Double Beat Valves

Fabricated dual-seat balanced equilibrium valve designed for high-volume gas and steam flow throttling requiring low actuating forces even under high line pressures.

Design:Pressure-Balanced Dual Plugs
Torque:Ultra-Low Operating Force
Media:Hot Process Gases & Steam
100% Dual Perimeter
FGD & SCR Isolation Ø500 - Ø5,000 mm

Twin Seal Flap Damper Valves

Dual sealing perimeter on a single flap blade with intermediate pressurized seal air chamber. Delivers 100% gas-tight human safety in flue gas desulfurization (FGD) systems.

Sealing:100% Zero Leakage
Seal Air:Dedicated Overpressure Blower
Application:Thermal Power Plant FGD / SCR
Chimney Heat Retention
Stack Termination Ø500 - Ø6,000+ mm

Stack Damper Valves

Installed at boiler stack and chimney tops to prevent heat loss during boiler shut-down and protect internal refractories from torrential monsoon rain and weather ingress.

Weather Proof:Integral Rain Hood & Drainage
Benefit:Accelerates Warm Boiler Restart
Actuation:Weather-Protected Electric / Pneumatic
Fire & Smoke Barrier
Fusible Link / Fail-Safe Custom Duct Sizing

Fire Damper Valves

Certified life-safety dampers featuring thermal fusible links (72°C / 95°C) and motorized spring-return actuators for automatic barrier shutoff during building and marine fire alarms.

Thermal Release:72°C / 95°C Fusible Link
Fail-Safe:Mechanical Spring Close
Applications:Marine HVAC & Industrial Ducts
